_comment: Golden contract for the matcher. Every case here is a real behaviour that was observed against a live server (or a near-miss that would have shipped). Changing behaviour means changing this file deliberately.

normalize.why: trailing punctuation: ListenBrainz titles carry it, library tags often do not
non-breaking hyphen U+2010, which ListenBrainz emits, vs a plain hyphen
CJK titles contain no a-z0-9, so stripping collapses both to '' — without the empty-string guard these compare EQUAL and bind the wrong song
different CJK artists must not collapse and match

resolve.why: THE IMPOSTOR: same title, different artist. Observed live — a same-title fallback put Kings of Leon's 'Notion' into the playlist for The Rare Occasions'. Must resolve to nothing.
the real track wins even when the impostor is returned first
punctuation difference on both fields still matches
CJK wrong title with the SAME artist must not resolve (the empty-collapse bug)
empty artist on the candidate must not match a real artist
